title: RCS Worldwide Promotes Alissa Pollack To President Of Mediabase
summary: Alissa Pollack has been promoted to president of Mediabase, the music industry’s premier source for airplay analytics, RCS Worldwide announced Monday. title: Oak View Group Names Tyler Bates SVP Programming Of UBS Arena
summary: Oak View Group (OVG) and UBS Arena announced that Tyler Bates has been named Senior Vice President, Programming of UBS Arena. Effective immediately, Bates will lead the arena’s programming strategy, overseeing the booking and development of concerts, sporting events, comedy, family entertainment, special events and other live experiences at the arena and its ancillary spaces.
